entities.name: Andrés Arauz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andrés Arauz Galarza is an Ecuadorian politician and economist who served as the General Secretary of the Citizen Revolution Movement (RC) since 2023. He previously served as president of RC from 2020 to 2021, and as Minister of Knowledge and Human Talent under Rafael Correa from 2015 to 2017.

entities.summary: Andrés Arauz Galarza is an Ecuadorian politician and economist who served as the General Secretary of the Citizen Revolution Movement (RC) since 2023.
